title: Tighter CAU2 Auth2-Advantage Bound
summary: The paper obtains an indirect authenticity bound through generic reductions; a tighter direct bound for the stated adversary remains open.

formal_statement.body: Directly bound the CAU2 auth2 advantage for multiple users and verification queries more tightly than the bound obtained via generic reductions.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption security, focusing on CAU2 authenticity under multi-user, multi-verification-query adversaries.
parameters: Multiple users and verification queries, defining the adversary's query scope
scope.unresolved_remainder: A direct analysis yielding a tighter auth2-advantage bound for the multiple-user, multiple-verification-query setting remains open.

progress.summary: The source explicitly labels this an interesting open question. It asks for a direct analysis of the relevant adversary and a better auth2-advantage bound than the one obtained through generic reductions.
citation_labels: Mihir Bellare et al., Nonces Are Noticed: AEAD Revisited
